_doc: First-launch disclaimer shown by both apps before the Home screen (Epic 6b, #87). Language-neutral and loaded verbatim by iOS and Android so the text — and the SHA-256 consent hash both platforms compute over this file's raw bytes — are identical. The hash is the consent key: editing ANY byte here (including `version`) changes the hash, which re-shows the gate on next launch (the 'version-refreshing click-through'). This is the distilled, in-app summary; the full, governing texts are the hosted EULA and Privacy Policy linked below.
title: Before you start
body: Semaphore Translator is for learning, practice, and entertainment only.
It estimates flag-semaphore arm positions from your camera using on-device pose estimation, and it can misread or miss a position. Results are best-effort and are not a guarantee.

Don't rely on it for emergencies, safety-critical or operational use, navigation, or passing along important information. The worst case is a wrong character on your screen — keep your use to where that is harmless.
Camera frames are processed live on your device and are never stored or transmitted. The app needs no network and works fully offline.
This is pre-release beta software, provided “as is”, without warranty of any kind. It may change or be withdrawn at any time.
agreement: By tapping “Agree & Continue” you confirm you have read this notice and agree to the End User License Agreement and Privacy Policy.
